title: Online Discrepancy for Sub-Exponential Product Distributions via Regularization
summary: We study online discrepancy minimization for independent random vectors in $\mathbb{R}^n$ with independent coordinates. Our deterministic algorithms require no knowledge of the horizon, and their guarantees hold at every prescribed deterministic terminal time $T$. For unit-variance sub-exponential coordinates with $ψ_1$-norms at most $σ$, we obtain terminal discrepancy $O(σ^4\sqrt n)$ with failure probability $\exp(-Ω(σ^3\sqrt n))$.
